events.title: Poppy Playtime
events.summary: At Boulevard City, step into the eerie world of Poppy Playtime, where an abandoned toy factory hides sinister secrets. This immersive hide-and-seek horror challenge keeps you on edge as every shadow and corner could be a safe haven—or a trap. Combining suspense, mystery, and thrilling interactive gameplay, Poppy Playtime delivers one of most unforgettable and spine-tingling adventures. Book Now
events.image_alt: Poppy Playtime

events.title: Riyadh Season: BLVD City
events.summary: Boulevard City is one of Riyadh Season’s most iconic entertainment hubs, offering a vibrant mix of attractions, from the dazzling dancing fountain to upscale dining, shopping, theaters, and immersive experiences for all ages. Visitors can explore OLULOU, where a towering dinosaur skeleton offers the perfect photo op, and let kids dive into four imaginative zones at PLAY-TOPIA. For thrill-seekers, Poppy Playtime delivers suspense inside an abandoned toy factory, A Lot Like Life challenges your bravery in a zombie outbreak, and The Conjuring opens October 15 with spine-chilling scenes from the haunted universe of Annabelle. Families can brave the haunted farm at Zeela House, while pop culture lovers enjoy FUNKO (from Nov 15), with giant figures and collectibles, and gamers embark on a real-world adventure inside MINECRAFT (also from Nov 15). Launching December 18, Flying Over Saudi offers a groundbreaking 5D flight experience that takes you on a 7-minute immersive ride above Saudi Arabia’s most iconic landmarks.
events.image_alt: Riyadh Season: BLVD City

events.title: The Groves
events.summary: The Groves offers a multi-sensory experience that transforms with each season. Every chapter brighter, richer, and more captivating than the last. events.title: Immersive Experience: Flying Over Saudi
events.summary: “Flying Over Saudi” at Boulevard City, Riyadh offers a one-of-a-kind tourism and entertainment experience—the first of its kind in the Kingdom—inviting visitors into a fully immersive theater that engages all five senses through stunning visuals, surround sound, realistic motion, touch, and scent. Enjoy a 7-minute aerial tour that feels like flying, taking you across Saudi Arabia’s most breathtaking natural landscapes and iconic landmarks in an unforgettable, awe-inspiring journey through the Kingdom’s highlights. events.title: Horses and Equestrian Heritage Exhibition
events.summary: The King Abdulaziz Public Library is hosting a specialized exhibition on horses and equestrian heritage in celebration of Saudi Founding Day. The exhibition showcases a rich collection of manuscripts, rare books, photographs, historical documents, Islamic miniatures, and illustrated works highlighting the deep-rooted equestrian legacy of the Kingdom. Marking four decades of preserving cultural heritage, the library also presents selections from its dedicated Equestrian Center, which houses more than 12,000 rare Arabic and international references on horses, alongside historic photographs captured by Princess Alice of Britain during her 1938 visit to Saudi Arabia.

events.title: Solo Art Exhibition Series
events.summary: Misk Art Institute presents the third edition of the Solo Series, spotlighting established Saudi artists Fouad Mougharbel and Saad Almasari, whose work has contributed significantly to the Kingdom’s evolving visual culture. Through two individual exhibitions—“Taibah: Remnants and Solace” by Dr. Fouad Mougharbel and “Geometry as Thought” by Saad Almasari—the series offers insight into their artistic journeys and practices, reflecting their sustained engagement with the local art scene. Together, the exhibitions highlight diverse perspectives and approaches that contribute to shaping Saudi Arabia’s contemporary artistic identity. Alongside the exhibitions, a curated public program provides opportunities for deeper engagement: Exhibition Program: May 6: Artist Signing with Dr. Fouad Mougharbel & Saad Almasari | 7 PM May 7: Curator-Led Tour | 6 – 7 PM Artist Talk with Dr. Fouad Mougharbel | 8 – 8:45 PM Artist Talk with Saad Almasari | 9 – 9:45 PM May 9 Workshop: Exhibition Design | 7 – 9 PM May 9 – 11 Intensive Workshop: Pattern Design (Inspired by Saad Almasari) | 7 – 9 PM. May 16: Artist in Focus: Saad Almasari | 7 – 9 PM June 3: Curator-Led Virtual Tour | 7 – 8 PM For the latest updates and announcements, follow their official X account @MiskArtInst

events.title: Hayy Arts | Global Positioning System
events.summary: Opening May 20, 2026, ‘Global Positioning System’ is an upcoming exhibition curated by Indranjan Banerjee and Lucas Morin. Global Positioning System is an exhibition dedicated to mapping and navigation systems. It tells stories of fast cars and slow trains, street barriers and trembling grounds, warping highways and broken bridges.
events.image_alt: Hayy Arts | Global Positioning System

events.title: Hayy Arts | Red Wind, Coral Worlds
events.summary: Opening May 20, 2026, ‘Red Wind, Coral Worlds’ is an upcoming exhibition curated by recipients of the Art Jameel Curatorial Open Call, Huda Tayob and Miriam Hillawi Abraham. Red Wind, Coral Worlds sites the Red Sea within an expanded and interconnected oceanic terrain. The exhibition traces the entangled worlds that converge across its waters, attending to the material and affective remnants left in the wake of centuries of movement and migration shaped by trade, pilgrimage, and displacement.

events.title: Art Futures Camp 2026 – Diriyah Art Futures
events.summary: Art Futures Summer Camp for Arabic-Speaking Teens is a three-week immersive programme hosted by Diriyah Art Futures (DAF), the MENA region’s first centre dedicated to New Media Arts. Designed for Arabic-speaking teens aged 14–18, the camp offers an in-depth introduction to digital art practices in a dynamic and supportive environment. Under the 2026 theme, “Digital Art and Portraiture,” participants explore new ways of representing identity in the digital age, questioning how individuals are portrayed when faces become data and images circulate beyond physical presence. The programme combines creative experimentation with foundational technical skills, including Fab Lab practices and digital studio portraiture. Throughout the camp, participants work closely with industry specialists and creative mentors, culminating in a collaborative exhibition produced with DAF’s curatorial and exhibition teams to showcase their work. Applications are officially open, with aspiring young creatives in Riyadh able to apply until Sunday, June 7.

events.title: Esports World Cup
events.summary: The Esports World Cup 2026 returns to Riyadh from 6 July to 23 August, delivering a summer-long celebration of elite competition and live entertainment as top clubs and players battle across multiple genres and platforms. With a lineup spanning tactical shooters, MOBAs, fighting games, strategy, racing, and even chess—including global favourites such as League of Legends, Counter-Strike 2, Fortnite, and Rocket League—the festival reinforces Riyadh’s role as a leading hub for international esports. New for 2026, Trackmania joins the programme, bringing high-precision racing where competitors chase the fastest times on one of esports’ most skill-intensive stages. The Esports World Cup, a multi-game global esports tournament and festival, will unite the global e-gaming community, including players, fans, game producers, and publishers, with a focus on fostering connections and collaborations.

events.title: البرنامج الصيفي بجامعة الجوف 2026
events.summary: تطلق جامعة الجوف البرنامج الصيفي بجامعة الجوف 1447هـ – 2026م، بوصفه برنامجًا نوعيًا متكاملًا يستهدف تنمية المهارات وتطويرها، ونشر ثقافة الابتكار، وترسيخ ثقافة التطوع وخدمة المجتمع، بما يعزز دور الجامعة التنموي والمجتمعي، ويفتح مسارات واسعة لاستثمار فترة الصيف في برامج معرفية وتدريبية وتطوعية ورياضية موجهة لمنسوبي الجامعة وطلبتها والخريجين وأفراد المجتمع. ويستهدف البرنامج، الذي يمتد من شهر يوليو حتى نهاية أغسطس 2026م، أكثر من 16,000مستفيد من داخل الجامعة وخارجها، من خلال أكثر من 50 برنامجًا وفعالية نوعية، وما يزيد على 210 ساعة تدريبية مكثفة، إلى جانب مشاركة أكثر من 300 متطوع أكاديمي وطبي، وتنفيذ أكثر من 11,000 ساعة تطوعية معتمدة، إضافة إلى أكثر من 10 بطولات رياضية صيفية.

events.title: Echoes of the Familiar
events.summary: Echoes of the Familiar exhibition explores the concept that home transcends mere physical space, embodying a tapestry of memories intricately woven into its very walls. It is within these confines that the echoes of laughter from childhood games intermingle with the remnants of disagreements and tears shed upon pillows. Each drawer brims with knick-knacks whose purposes remain elusive yet evoke nostalgia. The scent of maternal cooking and the rhythmic snoring of a father create a comforting ambiance, while the presence of a grandmother before the television grounds us in familial continuity. These shared experiences resonate universally, forging a collective nostalgia for "al zaman al Jameel
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Echoes of the Familiar

events.title: Tafasahu: Make Room
events.summary: Tafasahu: Make Room is an exhibition that showcases a commissioned installation by Saudi architect and artist, Nada AlMulla, which invites you to enter as a guest—to pause, gather and reflect on the conditions of belonging within the context of the traditional Majlis, Arabic for "gathering space." Beyond being a place to receive and host guests, the Majlis has been a vessel for the transmission of knowledge and heritage. The installation deconstructs this space into its essential elements while centering stories, memories and subtle traces of everyday life that animated it: conversations shared over coffee, the lingering scent of incense, the rhythms of gathering and departure. Hospita
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra

events.title: Beaded plant Suncatcher
events.summary: Sunlight has a way of bringing a space to life. As it passes through a window, it fills a room with color, movement, and small moments that make a house feel like home. In this workshop, participants create beaded plant sun catchers inspired by the light that streams through our windows and the natural elements we welcome into our homes. By combining colorful beads and delicate forms, each piece is designed to catch and reflect sunlight, creating shifting patterns of color and light. The result is a decorative artwork that celebrates the warmth of home through nature, color, and light.

Openings for air, layers for protection, and smart use of materials begin to appear in their designs. What starts in nature slowly turns into a built form.

events.title: Mirror Or Window

Through guided observation and creative response, children interpret what they see and translate it into visual expression. The experience results in personal interpretations shaped by both recognition and discovery.

events.title: My Family Bouquet
events.summary: A bouquet grows, one flower at a time. In this hands-on workshop, children begin with simple shapes and watch them take form as each piece is rolled, combined, and built into a flower. Colors are chosen, details are added, and the process repeats, each new bloom adding to the whole. As the bouquet comes together, each flower stands for someone at home, gathered into one arrangement shaped through making and choice.

events.title: Our Place on Earth
events.summary: A house in the desert is not built like one by the sea, and for good reason. In this experience, children explore how homes respond to their environments, from heat to movement to moisture. This leads into building and testing simple structures, adjusting them to stand against different conditions.

events.title: Treasures in Every Home
events.summary: Deep within the Earth, metal begins its journey, formed over time and transformed into materials we use every day at home. In this interactive workshop, children follow this journey, then reshape a simple tin container into a new functional object. The activity introduces how materials can be reused and redesigned for new purposes..
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Treasures in Every Home

events.title: Where We Belong
events.summary: Look closely at Earth, and it begins to feel like a system that never stops working; air moving, water cycling, living things adapting. In this program, children explore how life continues and changes across different environments, and how organisms adjust to survive over time. The journey then stretches further, looking at how science studies these systems and reimagines them beyond Earth. The experience connects life, environment, and possibility in one continuous story.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Where We Belong

events.title: Who Lived Here?
events.summary: Every landscape shapes the homes built within it. This treasure hunt in Rehlaat Gallery, children follow clues across three environments: desert, mountain, and coast. Each stop reveals a model home designed in response to its surroundings, from materials and structure to layout and function. As they move between locations, children match clues to the correct homes, discovering how climate, terrain, and daily life influence the way people build and live.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Who Lived Here?

events.title: Zoom In
events.summary: A tiny fragment holds the clue. In this Praise of the Artisan treasure hunt, children begin with a zoomed-in detail taken from a larger artwork, a pattern, texture, or small visual hint. Moving through the space, they search for the full piece, matching what they see up close with what appears on the walls. As the search unfolds, attention shifts to details that are often overlooked, building observation skills through careful looking. Each match reveals the complete artwork behind the fragment.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Zoom In

events.title: In the Home of…
events.summary: Some homes are easy to recognize. Others leave clues behind. In this interactive library experience, children move through a series of spaces, each one arranged as a “home” shaped by a well-known literary character. Objects, layouts, and small details hint at who might live there. As they explore each corner, children follow prompts and challenges that guide them to observe, connect, and identify the character behind each space. The experience unfolds step by step, turning the library into a trail of clues where stories are discovered through place, detail, and interaction.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: In the Home of…

events.title: My Little Fort

events.title: The House of Ideas
events.summary: We begin with a simple question: Where do ideas live? Like us, ideas need a place where they feel safe in a space that inspires them and gives them room to grow. In this experience, we explore the House of Ideas: where we will see how a thought begins, what nurtures it and how we can create spaces that allow it to flourish. By designing a pop-up house inside a notebook, participants build a small, personal world where their ideas can live and take shape. Through cutting, folding and creating, a quiet reflection unfolds: what helps our ideas grow, and where do they truly belong

events.title: Merath – Middle East Museums & Heritage Expo
events.summary: Taking place at the Riyadh Front Exhibition & Convention Center, Merath – Middle East Museums & Heritage Expo is the Kingdom’s first dedicated trade event for museums, heritage, and cultural development. The three-day exhibition brings together more than 100 exhibiting companies and over 3,000 visitors, including museums, galleries, science centers, cultural institutions, government entities, private collectors, and heritage developers. Co-located with the Saudi Entertainment and Amusement Expo (SEA Expo) and the Saudi Light and Sound Expo (SLS Expo), Merath provides a strategic platform to connect with decision-makers and explore opportunities within Saudi Arabia’s rapidly expanding $67 billion heritage and museum market, reinforcing Riyadh’s role as a growing hub for cultural innovation and investment.

events.title: Low-Budget Films – Opportunity, Artistic Choice, or a Phase?
events.summary: This panel sheds light on the experience of low-budget filmmaking as one of the production models adopted by filmmakers. events.title: Car Making Lego Station
events.summary: Come and build with us! Create your own Formula cars and racing models using Lego. It is a fun place to design and show your skills to everyone. Add your special car to our racing gallery for all fans to see.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Car Making Lego Station

events.title: F1 Driver Exhibition
events.summary: Explore our special exhibition featuring real racing gear, from driver suits to helmets to Formula cars. See the amazing details of the equipment used by the best on the track. This is a great chance for every racing fan!
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: F1 Driver Exhibition

events.title: F1 Simulators Activity
events.summary: Feel the excitement of Formula 1! Step into our motion simulators and experience the track like never before. Whether you are playing for fun or want to race like a professional, come and join us for a fast and thrilling ride.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: F1 Simulators Activity

events.title: Musical Band
events.summary: Enjoy live music at the event! The band will play a variety of songs and tunes to create a great atmosphere. Listen to the performances and enjoy the music as you walk around.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Musical Band

events.title: Spend an hour with one of the theater experts
events.summary: Get the chance to spend an hour with a theater expert to discuss variety of theater related subjects such as, production and design, lighting, sound, programing cultural events and marketing for theater. For June, meet Andrew Cummins production manager, and learn all there is to know about the role the production and design can play in theatrical performance.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Spend an hour with one of the theater experts

events.title: Jewelry Making: Rings 101
events.summary: A practical, entry-level course catered to Individuals interested in hands-on craftsmanship, hobbyists, aspiring jewelers, or creative professionals looking to experience traditional jewelry-making techniques. During this course, participants will create their own rings using traditional jewelry-making techniques. Furthermore, they are guided through shaping, soldering, and finishing processes. Hence, participants are able to gain a hands-on insight into the craftsmanship behind fine jewelry. Course Objectives: To introduce participants to basic jewelry-making tools and their uses To teach essential metalworking techniques To guide participants through the process of creating a wearable ring
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.venue: Ithra - Ithra Tower - Level 7, Art Studio
events.image_alt: Jewelry Making: Rings 101

events.title: Humood AlKhudher - An Eid Celebration at Ithra Theater
events.summary: Humood Alkhudher returns once again to Ithra Theater as part of this year’s Eid al-Adha celebrations, bringing a live concert filled with joy and festive spirit. For three days, audiences will enjoy one of the Gulf’s most prominent contemporary voices performing beloved songs. Join us to celebrate Eid together!
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Humood AlKhudher - An Eid Celebration at Ithra Theater

events.title: E.T
events.summary: A timeless story of friendship and empathy between a child and an outsider. Through care and connection, the film reflects how belonging is created through understanding.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: E.T

events.title: Warm Echos
events.summary: A collection of short films celebrating human connection, simple and gentle stories that leave a warm and lasting feeling. Catfish: As Elise moves into a new apartment with her parents, her pet cat Roger turns into a goldfish. Distraught, she goes back to her childhood home to turn him back. Luce and the Rock: A gentle, slow-paced tale about curiosity and fear. Through minimal visuals and little dialogue, the film shows how openness and trust can help us accept others.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Warm Echos

events.title: Eid Stories
events.summary: Join us with your family at Ithra Library during Eid Al-Adha where we follow the storyteller’s attempts to show us why Eid at his home is truly special. Along the way, we discover that Eid moves feelings and fills homes! We then continue with a fun interactive activity, where we share our thoughts and write Eid messages, expressing gratitude to our families and celebrating the special feelings Eid brings.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Eid Stories

events.title: Grandma’s Eid Tales
events.summary: Join us in celebrating the festive spirit at Grandma’s House, a place that brings generations together and is filled with cherished memories and a festive atmosphere. Enjoy this heartwarming show that transports you to the authentic spirit of the holiday, where storytelling blends with sounds, melodies and joy, inviting the nostalgia and the delight of Eid.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Grandma’s Eid Tales

events.title: Song of the Sea
events.summary: A visually poetic story about two siblings discovering memory and belonging. The film gently explores family bonds and the meaning of finding one’s “home” in another.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Song of the Sea

events.title: Sounds of Joy
events.summary: Enjoy the live musical performances at the Lush Garden from various Muslim countries such as Saudi Arabia, Oman, Morocco, Egypt, Indonesia and Uzbekistan, as they fill the atmosphere with melodies rooted in celebrating the heritage of our Eid holiday!
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Sounds of Joy

events.title: Eid Competition
events.summary: What is Eid without challenges and participation? And how can its joy be complete if we do not gather, laugh, and compete together? At the Children’s Museum Amphitheater, an exciting atmosphere inspired by the spirit of Eid comes to life. You will take part in fun questions, quick challenges, and visual and sound-based games full of surprises. We cheer, collaborate, and support our teams… because Eid is complete through participation, and joy grows through friendly competition.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Eid Competition

events.title: Audience Challenge
events.summary: Are you ready for a fun challenge? In this family game, we celebrate Eid together in front of the screen, competing as if we were live on air! Together, we answer questions, move through the points, and enjoy the excitement of the competition.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Audience Challenge

events.title: Eid Cabinet
events.summary: An interactive experience filled with joy and wonder! What if we traveled around the world to see how people celebrate Eid? And how can we design a unique outfit that reflects joy from different parts of the world? In this colorful journey, you will explore Eid outfits from diverse cultures and create your own designs using fun techniques and creative methods. Along the way, you will watch a short showcase celebrating the beauty of traditional attire and the customs of Eid Al-Adha. For every outfit tells a story, and every story carries a joy that lights up Eid.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Eid Cabinet

events.title: Home Scent
events.summary: Have you ever wondered how the scent of Eid fills our homes? And can we create this fragrance with our own hands? In this experience, you will explore the secrets of making incense from a variety of natural ingredients and discover the different types of oud and their distinctive aromas. A sensory journey infused with the spirit of Eid, bringing back the warmth of homes and the gathering of loved ones.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Home Scent

events.title: At Elevation
events.summary: How does a balloon rise into the sky? Can happiness soar just like it? What if we create a shiny balloon with our own hands and let it rise with our joy? In this playful experience, we discover the fun of shaping balloons. We experiment, wonder, and laugh together… will we see happiness grow as it floats higher and higher?.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: At Elevation

events.title: Home Frame
events.summary: In this program, children create a meaningful art frame inspired by Eid memories and the warmth of home, capturing family, joy, and imagination in one creative experience.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Home Frame

events.title: The Taste of Nostalgia
events.summary: A sensory journey into traditional Eid Al-Adha sweets, where families explore different flavors and bake delicious maamoul together. This warm, family-centered experience reflects the comfort of home and strengthens shared memories with an authentic taste passed across generations.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: The Taste of Nostalgia

events.title: Dots of Joy
events.summary: A joyful art adventure filled with colors and laughter! In it, children place their colorful stickers to express their Eid feelings on a white space, which gradually transforms into a lively, vibrant artwork. Every dot carries a smile, and together we create a happiness that keeps growing.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Dots of Joy

events.title: Eid News
events.summary: We wish you a blessed Eid Al-Adha. Here is your chance to become the announcer sharing the news of Eid in your own voice. A joyful, celebratory moment that captures the spirit of participation and festive excitement.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Eid News

events.title: Capture the Joy!
events.summary: Take a photo by one of our photographers who roam around the Center, and keep your photo as a souvenir from your visit to Ithra during Eid al-Adha!
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Capture the Joy!

events.title: Eid Spectrum
events.summary: Step into an interactive art and science experiment where energy, color, and emotion come alive. Using a magical powder that reacts to touch, visitors will see how their body temperature transforms into vibrant colors, revealing how heat turns into visible energy.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Eid Spectrum

events.title: Eid Tea Tales
events.summary: Immerse yourself in an experience where science blends with the warmth of tea, and emotions are crafted through flavor. Discover the origins of tea, explore how brewing methods shape every cup and step into an interactive tasting corner filled with different flavors. From aroma to taste, uncover how tea can influence our emotions and create moments of warmth and comfort.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Eid Tea Tales

events.title: Family Studio
events.summary: Step into the Family Studio, a lively workshop space designed for children and their caregivers to explore, create, and play side-by-side. Rooted in hands-on activities and playful experiments, every session invites you to dive into a new theme inspired by culture, imagination, and discovery. Here, little hands build, mold, explore textures, and create — while young minds spark with creativity, whether it’s crafting, exploring nature, or being innovative. The Family Studio celebrates the joy of learning through doing, all while sharing meaningful moments with family. Join us for an experience where imagination flows freely, creativity blooms, and cultural stories come alive throu
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Family Studio

events.title: Journey of Emotions
events.summary: Join us for a unique sensory experience, where the holiday transforms into a world you can see, hear, smell and taste. From Saudi Arabia to Amman, from Uzbekistan to Indonesia and Morocco, a journey that blends art, the senses and memories, you are welcome to wander through rooms, each of which captures a different aspect of the holiday atmosphere—from its joyful sounds and unique scents to its traditional sweets and dishes and even its colorful attire. Click here to join the virtual queue.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Journey of Emotions

events.title: Make It Eid
events.summary: This workshop invites you to decorate the Eid walls at Ithra with traditional decorations. Click here to join the virtual queue.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Make It Eid

events.title: On Grandma’s Wall
events.summary: In this open art experience, we celebrate Eid within a space inspired by Grandma’s house, where warm memories return with a fresh, contemporary spirit. Visitors step into a world that blends nostalgia with technology, taking part in creating a living mural using virtual reality.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: On Grandma’s Wall

events.title: Story in the Scent
events.summary: In this display, we invite you to discover the various fragrances inspired by the cities of the Kingdom—from incense to flowers—and uncover the magic of each fragrance and its unique ways of blending. As fragrance has always been an integral part of our Eid rituals, participants will embark on a sensory experience to relate each scent to a story and to cherish memories.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Story in the Scent

events.title: Sustainability Studio
events.summary: Enjoy a hands-on experience by printing on plates made from paper. Participants will try their hand at printing, decorate the plate pieces, and take home their hand-painted creations. This workshop celebrates sustainability, offering visitors a unique and immersive way to creativity and Sustainability.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: Sustainability Studio

events.title: The Emotion Scent Journey
events.summary: What might a fragrance crafted by your own hands reveal? Discover the connection between scents and emotions, and how certain fragrances can bring back memories and influence the way we feel. Through a variety of aromatic notes, participants will create their own scent bag by selecting and blending fragrances that reflect their personality and emotions.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: The Emotion Scent Journey

events.title: The Hidden Hue
events.summary: Join us into a creative workshop where colors and shapes speak the language of emotion. Participants explore how light and form express feelings without words, and how visual energy shapes mood and balance. This is where emotions become visible.
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.image_alt: The Hidden Hue

events.title: Toddler’s Space
events.summary: A dedicated space for children from birth to three years old, offering opportunities for exploration and play in a safe, warm environment inspired by the spirit of Eid, with a focus on developing early sensory and motor skills.

events.image_alt: Toddler’s Space

events.summary: Join us for an enriching session where we explore literary debate, its concept and objectives, and learn the foundations of building compelling literary arguments. We will also develop persuasion and audience engagement skills, while highlighting the ethics of debate and the etiquette of dialogue that foster thoughtful discussions, enrich ideas and celebrate diverse perspectives.

events.title: Material Library Experience
events.summary: Explore natural dyes through a hands-on experience at Idea Lab’s Material Library. Discover the vibrant colors in plants and everyday ingredients and explore a unique collection of unconventional and sustainable materials. The Material Library at Ithra is the first of its kind in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It is a physical and digital material library curated in collaboration with Colab in Dubai to be an inspiring resource for sustainable and unique materials. The library offers its visitors, from designers, artists, and professionals in various fields, the opportunity to peruse a rich collection of materials from around the world, alongside materials from local and regional supplier

Designed to break away from traditional boundaries, the workshop ignites creativity and encourages bold experimentation. Participants enter a virtual artistic space that invites them to explore, collaborate and take on creative challenges—leading to the creation of innovative artworks that go beyond the familiar and open new horizons of imagination.

events.title: Aramcorama Exhibit
events.summary: Aramcorama celebrates the legacy of Saudi Aramco through carefully curated historical images, documents and artifacts. These unique objects capture the creation of the company and its pioneering efforts to provide opportunities and technological advances which helped lay the foundation for the modern Saudi state. The history of Saudi Aramco, as captured by records drawn from its archival collections, illustrates the collective effort that has transformed the Kingdom’s energy resources into a driver of the world’s economy.

events.title: In Praise of the Artisan
events.summary: Despite the devastating effect of mass production, industrialization and the related decline in quality and aesthetics, as well as a low status of crafts compared to the fine arts, the last decade has shown encouraging signs of a new revival and interest in contemporary practice of traditional Islamic arts and crafts around the world. Museums are beginning to treat Islamic art as a living tradition by connecting Islamic art with craftspeople and their workshops in order to help make more sense of their historic collections. events.title: Creative Installations with Precast
events.summary: Precast refers to concrete elements that are manufactured and cast in molds off-site, then transported and assembled on-site. It’s often associated with standardization—efficiency, repetition and precision. It is widely used for its many advantages: high quality control, reduced construction time, cost efficiency, durability and the ability to produce consistent modular elements at scale. Yet beyond its industrial logic lies an untapped creative potential. This workshop challenges the conventional perception of precast by repositioning it as a medium for artistic and spatial exploration. events.title: Desert X AlUla 2026
events.summary: Returning for its fourth edition, Desert X AlUla 2026 explores Space Without Measure, inspired by Kahlil Gibran’s meditations on possibility, perception and the boundless nature of the human spirit. Large-scale, site-specific installations by Saudi and international artists respond to AlUla’s unique landscape, history, and culture. A vibrant programme of tours and events invites deeper engagement, continuing to build AlUla’s legacy as a global destination for art in the landscape. Desert X can be enjoyed in a variety of ways, including on foot - self-guided, or as part of a public or private guided tour - or in the comfort of an open-top car.

events.title: ورشة "فن التعامل مع كبار الشخصيات والمشاهير"
events.summary: عنوان الورشة او اللقاء: فن التعامل مع كبار الشخصيات والمشاهير المحاور: - مفهوم الاتصال. - تعريف البرتوكول والاتيكيت والمراسم والتشريفات. - من هم كبار الشخصيات والمشاهير. - بروتوكولات التعامل مع كبار الشخصيات. - الاتيكيت والذوق العام. - نماذج من البروتوكولات. الأهداف: - فن الإلقاء والتقديم وأساليب وطرق العرض. - مفهوم لغة الجسد وأهميتها في التعامل مع الأخرين. - الاستراتيجيات الأساسية في مهارات الحوار الفال. - البروتوكولات عند التعامل مع كبار الشخصيات والمشاهير. - بروتوكولات مصافحة كبار الشخصيات. الفئة المستهدفة: قطاع السياحة والترفيه والضيافة و موظفي الاتصال المؤسسي في كافة القطاعات. الموعد والموقع: اليوم ( الاربعاء) التاريخ ( 14/7/2025م ) الموقع (المسرح -القاعة - الأكاديمية ) من الساعه( 10ص ) الى الساعه ( 12م ) مقدم الورشة: أ‌. أنور بن أحمد حكمي- رئيس اللجنة القطاعية للسياحة والترفيه بالغرفة ومدرب معتمد

events.title: The Kingdom's Participation in the G20 Space Economy Leaders’ Meeting
events.summary: Today, the Kingdom, represented by the Saudi Space Agency, participated in the G20 Space Economy Leaders’ Meeting held in Bangalore, India, on Thursday and Friday, July 6 and 7,2023, where His Excellency the CEO of the Saudi Space Agency, Dr. Muhammad bin Saud Al Tamimi, headed the Kingdom’s delegation. The Meeting Of Space Leaders Is One Of The Outputs Of The Kingdom’s Presidency Of The G20, Which Included It For The First Time Among The Topics Of The Group’s Agenda, Through Which It Seeks To Enhance Space Cooperation Between Countries To Maximize The Benefits Of The Space Economy And The Benefits Of Using Space Data In Supporting Sustainable Development, Food Security And Global Health.

events.title: World Defense Show 2022
events.summary: The World Defense Show 2022, in its first edition, focused on the joint integration between air, land, and sea defense systems, satellites, and information security. The Kingdom organized it to become an integrated and unique exhibition of its kind that provides local and international manufacturers, parties concerned with the military and security industries sector, and all interested visitors a unified platform under one roof. It will be an anticipated addition to the series of international defense exhibitions around the world.
